name: meridian-mobile
description: Capacitor wrapper that ships Meridian's web UI as native iOS + Android apps, pointed at the hosted feed.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync && npm run version
scripts.add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios && npm run icons && npm run version && npx cap sync
scripts.add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android && npm run icons && npm run version && npx cap sync
